title: Expose the saved-progress outcome
goal_md: Tell a caller whether completed practice progress was actually persisted.

included: A caller-facing outcome for a failed write

constraints.text_md: Report saved only after persistence succeeds; failed writes remain visibly unsaved.

phases.title: Return and consume the save outcome
phases.objective_md: Callers can distinguish saved completion from a completion whose write failed.
phases.approach_md: Keep persistence behind a small result-returning boundary and pass the result through the completion caller without interpreting a notification as proof.

tasks.text_md: Implement the result-returning persistence boundary and caller propagation.
Verify successful read-back and failed-write preservation before reporting the outcome.

acceptance_criteria.text_md: A failed write returns unsaved and preserves the previous valid snapshot.
A successful write returns saved only after the persisted snapshot can be read back.

references.purpose_md: A short independently worded explanation of the result contract.

assets.purpose_md: A small diagram showing the distinction between a completed action and a persisted outcome.

metadata.fixture_warning: This package is illustrative and is not evidence of an implemented persistence layer.
